metadata.description: ShyPie — privacy-first workflow for DeepSeek Harness + Magpie: documents are converted to text locally and PII is replaced with placeholders before anything can reach a model or the session log.

ShyPie
Privacy-first workflow for DeepSeek Harness + Magpie
> Keep PII on your machine: images and PDFs are converted to text **locally**, the local transcript
> stays readable by default, and Magpie masks the text **before it leaves the machine**. Anything th

at
> cannot be masked or filtered is **blocked**, not sent.

This repository is a reference implementation of a two-plugin combo for
DeepSeek Harness (DSH) and M

epository is a reference implementation of a two-plugin combo for
DeepSeek Harness (DSH) and Magpie:
| Component | npm package | Role |
| `plugins/dsh-privacy-gate` | `@shypie_privacy/dsh-privacy-gate` | **ShyPie Filter** DSH host bundl
e: extracts attached images/PDFs locally, keeps tool/document text local by default, guards binary r

eads, and enforces a fail-closed `llm/stream` egress guard |
| Magpie middleware (merged in-tree) |
`@magpie-community/middleware-privacy-gate` | Magpie gateway middleware: rejects or withholds conten
t Magpie cannot mask (images, files, encoded blobs) for non-local models; `binaryPolicy: guide` with

holds bytes and asks the model to choose a local extraction tool |
| `packages/pii-core` | `@shypie_

privacy/pii-core` | Zero-dependency detector + keyed-placeholder library shared by both plugins |
|
`packages/local-extract` | `@shypie_privacy/local-extract` | Local-only PDF / Office / scan → text C
LI with fail-closed blocking |

All four ShyPie packages are now published at **`0.3.0`**: `pii-core`, `local-extract`, the DSH
bund

le, and the legacy Magpie package. The DSH bundle includes filter mode, image/PDF extraction and
the

composer switch. The Magpie middleware was **merged** into
magpie-community/plugins
at `28108dd` (P

R #685) as `@magpie-community/middleware-privacy-gate`; upstream is version `0.1.0`,
[该节后续省略]
## Why two plugins

1. **DSH's outbound request is immutable.** It is a deep-frozen fold of the session log
(`dsh-agent-

loop`, `markAgentLoopRequest`), so a plugin cannot rewrite it on the way out. ShyPie
Filter therefor

e does the local part it can do — extract attachments, block bytes it cannot mask,
and enforce the p

rovider allowlist — while Magpie masks text at the gateway.
2. **Magpie's masking is text-only.** It

s own documentation says *"Images and file data are sent as
they are. Text inside a screenshot is no

t masked."* A gateway can never mask a PDF page or a
screenshot, so the gateway must **reject or wit

hhold** what it cannot mask. With
`binaryPolicy: guide`, it replaces the bytes with metadata and a l

ocal-tool prompt; with the
default `fail`, it returns 403.
ShyPie Filter covers what enters the DSH session log; Magpie covers text masking and every other age

nt
behind the gateway (Cursor, Copilot, Claude Code, scripts). The default `textPolicy: filter` keep

s
raw local text; `textPolicy: mask` restores local placeholder masking.
## Architecture
[代码示例省略，未执行]
## What it protects
- **Tool and document ingress.** Tool-result text and locally extracted attachment text are kept in
the local transcript by default. PDFs, Office files, attached images and scans are converted with a
local extractor/OCR first; unmaskable BLOB/media is blocked. Error-result `meta` is not rewritten an

d
remains a documented local residual.
- **Local conversion only.** Text layers use `pdftotext`; sca

ns use `pdftoppm` plus a local OCR
adapter (on Windows, the built-in `Windows.Media.Ocr` engine — no

install, no network). If no
local engine exists the call is **blocked** (`NO_LOCAL_OCR`), never sen

t to a cloud converter.
- **Attachments are converted, not forwarded.** An attached image or PDF is

read through the
harness's attachment store, converted locally, and replaced by text *before* the me

ssage is logged —
the step is rejected when the bytes cannot be read (no extractor, failed verificat

ion, empty result,
`imageParts: 'block'` or `fileParts: 'block'`).
- **Un-maskable payloads are reje

cted or withheld**: base64/hex/`data:`-encoded documents
(contiguous, line-wrapped or dump-formatted

), image/file/audio parts to non-local providers,
unknown binaries, encrypted PDFs. In `textPolicy:

filter` the DSH egress guard allows plaintext
PII only through the default `magpie*` provider; Magpi

e must have Privacy masking enabled. For
other agents, `binaryPolicy: guide` replaces the binary par

t with type/size metadata and a prompt
to use a local extraction tool, without forwarding the bytes.
- **Round-trip without exposing values.** `privacy_rehydrate` resolves placeholders inside the tool
and returns only `{path, replaced, kinds}`; the model can fill a form without seeing the value.
## What it does not do
- **Free-text names** are outside deterministic detection (use the word list or a *local* classifier

).
- **Transformed values** (reversed, re-encoded) are not detected; zero-width and soft-hyphen tric

ks are.
- **Detector false negatives** are possible; the design is layered (rules → local gateway mo

del →
fail-closed blocks) but not complete. Read docs/design.md §12.
- **Local at-rest residues** ar

e named, not hidden: filter mode deliberately keeps raw tool/attachment
text in the local DSH transc

ript; DSH also records the raw submitted prompt before any plugin seam,
and Magpie's masking journal

keeps values for 30 days.
- **History predating installation** is replayed unchanged — start new se

ssions after installing.
- The plugins are **not installed by this repository**; installation change

s profile-wide state and
is documented step by step.
## Requirements

- Windows 10/11 (the OCR and path policy are Windows-first; the core libraries are portable).
- Deep

Seek Harness with a configurable plugin profile, and Magpie running its local gateway.
- `pdftotext`

/ `pdftoppm` / `pdfinfo` on `PATH` for PDF text and scan rendering (poppler).
- Node.js 22+ for the

test suite and CLI (the bundled DSH runtime works).
- Optional: `tesseract` (an adapter exists but

I (the bundled DSH runtime works).
- Optional: `tesseract` (an adapter exists but is untested here).

nd the composer switch. The Magpie middleware is merged in-tree at `magpie-community/plugins` but
